description:
Create a standard electrical motor control ladder diagram in LibreCAD. 

Goal: Draw a 3-rung schematic for a Start/Stop motor circuit with indicators.

Save the file to: '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/motor_control_ladder.dxf'

SPECIFICATIONS:

1. Layers & Colors:
   - Create layer 'POWER' (Color: Red)
   - Create layer 'RUNGS' (Color: Yellow)
   - Create layer 'SYMBOLS' (Color: Green)
   - Create layer 'TEXT' (Color: White/Black)

2. Power Rails (on layer 'POWER'):
   - Left Rail: Vertical line from (10, 10) to (10, 250)
   - Right Rail: Vertical line from (210, 10) to (210, 250)

3. Circuit Rungs (on layer 'RUNGS'):
   - Rung 1 (Motor Control) at Y=200: Horizontal line connecting rails (from X=10 to X=210)
   - Rung 2 (Pilot Light) at Y=140: Horizontal line connecting rails
   - Rung 3 (Overload Alarm) at Y=80: Horizontal line connecting rails

4. Components (on layer 'SYMBOLS'):
   - Draw simple circles (radius ~8) or arcs to represent these components:
     - Rung 1: Stop button (NC), Start button (NO), Motor Coil (M1)
     - Rung 2: Aux Contact (NO), Pilot Light (PL1)
     - Rung 3: Overload Contact (NC), Alarm Indicator (AL1)

5. Text Annotations (on layer 'TEXT'):
   - Rail Labels: 'L1' (top left), 'L2' (top right)
   - Components: 'STOP', 'START', 'M1', 'PL1', 'OL', 'AL1'
   - Title: 'MOTOR CONTROL - CONVEYOR M1' (placed at bottom or top)
